name: Chaas
steps: Whisk the plain curd in a jug until smooth, breaking up any lumps before adding liquid. Wash and finely chop the coriander.
Add chilled drinking water in two or three additions while whisking. The chaas should be evenly mixed and thin enough to pour freely.
Stir in cumin powder and salt. If using a blender, pulse only briefly to combine; prolonged blending creates unnecessary foam.
Fold in the chopped coriander, taste and adjust the seasoning lightly. Stir once more before pouring into glasses, as the herbs and spice can settle.
Serve chilled immediately, or keep covered in the refrigerator until serving. Give the jug a gentle stir again before portioning.
tips: Use plain curd. Mint can replace coriander.
substitutions: Any substitution changes the recipe: recheck allergies, Jain rules and quantities.
notes: Prices are sample ingredient-cost assumptions. Replace with supplier rates before procurement.
